risk.recursive-delete: It deletes a folder and everything inside it.
risk.stop-process: It closes running programs; unsaved work in them is lost.
risk.execution-policy: It changes which scripts Windows allows to run.
risk.service: It stops or changes a Windows service.
risk.scheduled-task: It creates or changes a scheduled task that runs later on its own.
risk.shutdown: It shuts down, restarts or signs out of this computer.
risk.accounts: It creates or changes user accounts.
risk.security-settings: It changes antivirus or firewall settings.
risk.elevation: It asks to run as administrator.
risk.obfuscation: Part of the command is hidden or built at run time, so Bochica can't check it.
risk.invisible-chars: It contains invisible characters that can hide what it really does.
risk.secret-upload: It may send passwords or keys over the internet.
risk.unknown-script: It runs a script or program whose contents Bochica can't check.

help.connected: Bochica can read and change your EPLAN projects. Every change asks you first.
help.busy: EPLAN is open but not answering, usually because a dialog is open in EPLAN. Close it and Bochica continues.
help.starting: Bochica is starting its EPLAN connection. This takes a few seconds.
help.not_configured: Part of Bochica that talks to EPLAN is missing from this computer. Install Bochica again to put it back; your conversations and settings are kept.
help.not_installed: Bochica can't find EPLAN Electric P8 on this computer. You can still ask questions about EPLAN; to work on projects, install EPLAN 2024 or newer and restart Bochica.
help.closed: Open EPLAN on this computer. Bochica connects on its own within 15 seconds.
help.unreachable: EPLAN is running but doesn't accept connections. Allow remote access in EPLAN once:
help.error: Bochica's EPLAN connection didn't start. Restart Bochica; if it keeps happening, the details below help to report it.

blocked.malformed: the command couldn't be read safely.

blocked.disk: it would format or wipe a disk.
blocked.system-delete: it would delete Windows, Program Files, a whole drive or a user's folders.
blocked.boot: it would change how Windows starts or delete backups.
blocked.download-exec: it would download something and run it.
blocked.invalid-path: the path isn't a valid file path.
blocked.protected-path: that folder is protected (passwords, browser data, Bochica's own data, or Windows).
blocked.secret-file: files like .env hold passwords and keys.
blocked.user-rule: one of your “Never allow” rules in Settings forbids it.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Instructions for specific kinds of work. The assistant uses a skill when a request needs it, or when you type / and its name. A skill only adds instructions: it never lets the assistant do more than the mode allows.
skills.missing: Bochica couldn't find this built-in skill. Install Bochica again to put it back.

problem.no-skill-file: There is no SKILL.md file in this folder.
problem.no-front-matter: SKILL.md must start with a header between --- lines, with a name and a description.
problem.bad-name: The name must use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (at most 64), like plc-labels.
problem.long-description: The description is longer than 1024 characters.
problem.too-large: The skill is too large (more than 200 files or 5 MB).
problem.injection: It contains text that tries to take control of the assistant.
problem.name-taken: A built-in skill or a command already uses that name.

findings.override: tells the assistant to ignore its instructions
findings.secret-read: asks to read passwords, keys or .env files

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: What Bochica may do without asking you. Commands that could wreck the computer are always blocked, whatever you set here.
permissions.smartDescription: Before asking you about a command, the AI model checks whether it only reads information. If it is clearly harmless, it runs without a card. Costs a short extra model call per command.
permissions.denyDescription: Commands that match one of these patterns are blocked, also in Auto mode. * stands for any text, ? for one character.
permissions.alwaysDescription: Added with “Always allow” on an approval card.

intro.title: Welcome to Bochica
intro.description: An assistant for your work with EPLAN Electric P8. You type what you need in plain words; Bochica does the rest.
intro.ask: Ask anything about EPLAN, with answers taken from its documentation, and get help writing EPLAN scripts.
intro.work: Let it work on your projects in EPLAN: read them, change properties, export, check.
intro.safe: It asks before changing anything, and backs a project up before its first change.

model.title: Connect an AI model
model.description: Bochica works with the AI provider you choose. Pick one and paste your API key, then test it. The key is stored encrypted on this computer.
model.ready: Ready: Bochica can talk to a model.

eplan.title: EPLAN on this computer
eplan.description: To work on projects, Bochica connects to EPLAN on its own. You don't need EPLAN to ask questions, so you can also sort this out later.

try.description: Ask this to check that everything works, or finish and start with your own.
